name: Mai-chan no Yuuwaku
source:
An adventure game to go wild with a pretty girl. A cute girl named Ai calls on you and starts seducing you.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ056672.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款与美少女尽情狂欢的冒险游戏。名叫麻衣的可爱女孩主动找上门来，向你展开了撩人的诱惑。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ056672.html/]DLsite英文版[/url]]
